# railway_environment (Data Source)

Railway environment. Look it up by `id`, or by `project_id` and `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "railway_environment" "production" {
  project_id = railway_project.example.id
  name       = "production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Identifier of the environment. Conflicts with `name`.
- `name` (String) Name of the environment. Requires `project_id`.
- `project_id` (String) Identifier of the project the environment belongs to.
